stories.title: Alberta government facing scrutiny over bourbon distilleries tour in Kentucky
stories.summary: The NDP says it amounts to a taxpayer-funded booze fest and has demanded the minister pay back $5,400 for the cost of the distillery tours.

stories.title: Paramedic widow learned husband was shot while trying to save second Edmonton officer
stories.summary: Dennis Okeymow apologized to the officers’ families as court heard victim impact statements and arguments over how long he should spend behind bars.

stories.title: Calgary budget proposes 15% property tax increase in 2027
stories.summary: If approved as proposed, Calgary's budget could result in a 37 per cent increase to city property taxes over the next four years.

stories.title: Cat dies after fire breaks out in basement of Calgary home
stories.summary: The Calgary Fire Department said its crews were called to the 100 block of Doverthorn Close SE around 4 a.m. Tuesday for reports of a fire.

stories.title: ‘Things will never be the same’: Wainwright prepares for Remembrance Day after fire
stories.summary: The Alberta town of Wainwright is gearing up for what could be the most solemn Remembrance Day in its recent history, says Mayor Bruce Pugh.

stories.title: Edmonton Elks, Montreal Alouettes arrive in Calgary ahead of 113th Grey Cup
stories.summary: The Elks and Alouettes are in Calgary preparing for Sunday's Grey Cup, with Edmonton back in the CFL championship for the first time since 2015.

stories.title: Frustration level high for beleaguered Canucks
stories.summary: Manny Malhotra knew this wouldn't be any easy season.

stories.title: Flyers outlast Canucks for 3-1 victory
stories.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers withstood a late rally to down the struggling Vancouver Canucks 3-1 on Monday.

stories.title: Levi gives Oilers confidence in the crease
stories.summary: The Edmonton Oilers are hoping they finally have the so-called goalie of the future in Devon Levi.

stories.title: Draisaitl scores twice as Oilers beat Rangers 3-1
stories.summary: Leon Draisaitl scored a pair of goals as the Edmonton Oilers swept their season series with New York, holding on to defeat the Rangers 3-1 on Monday.
